desc: Characterize \(f(L,R)\) as the number of maximal consecutive-value runs in the distinct-value set of the subarray.
Derive the fixed-right-endpoint formula using last occurrences: \(\sum_L f(L,R)=\sum_x\max(0,\mathrm{last}[x]-\mathrm{last}[x-1])\).
Implement the O(N) local-update invariant, updating only terms for \(p=A_R\) and \(p+1\), and validate on all samples.
